messages.subject: Trouble logging into http://spark.rstudio.com/8787/
parts:
I've been trying to log into RStudio server through their Shiny beta hosting page (http://spark.rstudio.com/8787/) all day, but it is not working.

When I got to the webpage, I get the login screen, and after entering username/password and logging in, I only get a spinning wheel.  Eventually I get the following popup: "error: download of http://spark.rstudio.com/8787/rstudio/deferredjs/.../21.cache.js?autoRetry=3 failed with status 0()."
Where "..." is a long alphanumeric string.

Is anyone else having this problem?
